_comment: AGENT: always read this file via the task-index-manager skill before reading or writing any task state.

tasks.title: Bug: parseRequestedBlock silently ignores ids after the first
tasks.notes: Fix when touched. Returns only first matched minecraft: id; multi-block messages lose later ids. Document before expanding material resolution.

tasks.title: Bug: managedBlocks unbounded cache in BridgeServer
tasks.notes: Fix when touched. Never evicts. Fine for dev session; add max-size cap or session-scoped reset for long-running server.

tasks.title: Bug: serverContextJson dimension format mismatch
tasks.notes: Fix when touched. Plugin sends NORMAL/NETHER/THE_END; TS fixtures use minecraft:overworld. Align if dimension becomes meaningful.

tasks.title: Phase 2 — Terrain Context and Blending (milestone)
tasks.notes: Umbrella: complete when 27–30 are done; then move 23 and 27–30 to done.json. specDocs.phase2. Benchmark harness (task 19): scorePlan + golden JSON; expand terrain-intrusion scoring once terrain context exists.

tasks.title: Phase 3 — Retrieval, Refinement, and Undo
tasks.notes: Retrieval library, bounded refinement loop with DIG patches, transaction log, undo buffer, material variety quality gates. Gate behind Phase 2 terrain stability. ON START: read tasks/phase-3-retrieval-refinement-undo.md (specDocs.phase3) and expand its subtasks into individual index.json entries before beginning implementation.

tasks.title: Decorative and Biome Style Expansion
tasks.notes: Richer detail passes, style presets, biome-aware material preferences, repair mode. Keep separate from correctness milestones. Needs terrain context (23) for biome awareness.

tasks.title: Nearby Build Preservation
tasks.notes: Detect likely player-made nearby structures. Add avoidance/protection policies during planning and execution. Requires stable terrain/context (23).

tasks.title: Phase 2.1 — TerrainContextCard generator
tasks.notes: Plugin terrain sampling (footprint + buffer), compact metrics (height/slope, top-block histogram, water proximity, biome mix), bounded payload + deterministic planner card text. terrain_context_enabled=false rollback. Tests: synthetic metrics, size cap, fallback. specDocs.phase2 Task 1.

tasks.title: Phase 2.2 — Terrain-adaptive compile transforms
tasks.notes: Cut/fill foundation (max cut depth), retaining wall, feathering ring, vegetation save/restore in blend ring where safe. terrain_blend=false rollback. Tests: max cut, region bounds, benchmark regressions. specDocs.phase2 Task 2.

tasks.title: Phase 2.3 — Placement and anchoring mode expansion
tasks.notes: Surface / inset / underground / elevated modes; no-target fallback samples build area ahead of player; directives (under here, into hill, beneath house); stronger tree-removal targeting. Low-confidence → surface mode. Tests: mode classification, anchor regressions, tree types. specDocs.phase2 Task 3.

tasks.title: Phase 2.4 — Primitive coverage for terrain-aware structures
tasks.notes: Harden ramps, tunnels, roof helpers, planes; deterministic compile, pass-order safe, safety limits. Feature-flag individual helpers if needed. Tests: uneven fixtures, pass-order + validation. Depends on 2.2 transforms. specDocs.phase2 Task 4.
